newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feed sharply higher with Chicago.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feed sharply higher with Chicago.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were sharply higher on Thursday with sellers taking their lead from the Chicago futures market.
U.S. soy futures closed with old crop soymeal limit up on talk of export business.
Sellers in the UK marked up ex-mill high protein soymeal by as much as eight stg a tonne while stores were around six stg higher.
Rapemeal rose by one stg a tonne from all the mills while sunflowermeal was two stg higher.
Brokers expected some interest for spot material but it did not materialise.

"Maybe it's just as well we did not do any business, because we now can't be accused of selling people material at the top of the market," said one broker following the fall in old crop Chicago soybeans at the opening on Thursday afternoon.
